title: Kyoto
description: Sam & Alex in Kyoto, 12–16 March 2027: day plans, maps, bookings and prices in USD.
week_title: One base, one direction each day
week_intro: Every day starts and ends at Ace Hotel, right on the subway hub. Mornings start early, and most afternoons have a hotel break from about 3pm (earlier on sunrise day).

areas.name: Downtown · Karasuma to Kawaramachi
areas.desc: Where you sleep. Covered shopping arcades, Nishiki Market, Weekenders and Ippodo are all a 5–15 minute walk from the hotel.

areas.name: Fushimi Inari
areas.far: 15–20 min by taxi · Keihan Line back
areas.desc: The torii-tunnel shrine on the south side of town. Open all night and free, so sunrise is the time to go.

areas.name: Gion · Higashiyama
areas.desc: The old east side under the hills: Yasaka Shrine, Maruyama Park and Kikunoi.

areas.name: Arashiyama · Sagano
areas.far: 30 min · Tōzai Line + Randen, or taxi
areas.desc: Bamboo, the river and Zen gardens on the far west edge. Quiet before 8am, packed by 10.

areas.name: Uji
areas.far: 45 min · Karasuma Line + JR Nara Line
areas.desc: Kyoto's tea town, south of the city. Byōdō-in and the old matcha houses on the river.

hotel.name: Ace Hotel Kyoto
hotel.note: Shin-Puh-Kan, 245-2 Kurumaya-chō, Nakagyō · Karasuma Oike Station exit 5 · sources list two street numbers, use the hotel's own

weekenders.name: Weekenders Coffee Tominokoji
weekenders.note: 560 Honeya-chō, behind a parking lot · 7:30–18:00 · closed Wednesdays · standing room, takeaway mostly

nishiki.name: Nishiki Market
nishiki.note: Nishikikōji-dōri · shops roughly 10:00–17:00, each sets its own hours · many close Wednesdays, some Sundays · no eating while walking

ippodo.name: Ippodo Tea, Kyoto main store
ippodo.q: Ippodo Tea Kyoto Main Store Teramachi
ippodo.note: Teramachi-dōri at Nijō · shop and Kaboku tearoom 10:00–17:00, last call 16:30 · no reservations · tearoom closed 2nd Wednesday

pontocho.name: Pontochō
pontocho.note: Lantern-lit alley by the Kamo River · small restaurants, many with menus posted outside

fushimi.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
fushimi.note: 68 Yabunouchi-chō · open 24 hours · free · Yotsutsuji viewpoint is ~45 min up

yasaka.name: Yasaka Shrine · Maruyama Park
yasaka.note: East end of Shijō-dōri · open 24 hours · free

kikunoi.name: Kikunoi Honten
kikunoi.q: 菊乃井 本店 京都
kikunoi.note: 459 Shimokawara-chō, Higashiyama · dinner 17:00, last order 19:30 · closed 1st and 3rd Tuesdays · +81-75-561-0015

tenryuji.name: Tenryū-ji garden
tenryuji.note: 8:30–17:00, last entry 16:50 · garden ¥500 · north gate opens onto the bamboo path

okochi.name: Ōkōchi Sansō
okochi.note: Top of the bamboo path · 9:00–17:00 · ¥1,000 incl. matcha and a sweet

byodoin.name: Byōdō-in
byodoin.note: Uji-renge 116 · grounds 8:30–17:30 · ¥700, Phoenix Hall interior +¥300 by timed ticket from 9:00

tokichi.name: Nakamura Tokichi Honten
tokichi.q: 中村藤吉本店 宇治
tokichi.note: By JR Uji Station · café from 10:00 or 11:00 (sources differ), last order 16:30 · numbered-ticket queue, no bookings

reservations.title: One table matters most
reservations.intro: Kikunoi on Sunday 14 is the trip. Everything else is walk-in. Booking times are Japan time, so check the difference from home.

priority.title: Kikunoi Honten
priority.meta: Kaiseki, 2 people · menus listed at ¥22,000–77,000 pp plus ~15% service (sources vary) · 459 Shimokawara-chō, Higashiyama. Open Sunday; closed 1st and 3rd Tuesdays.
priority.opens: Release window unconfirmed · request now on MY CONCIERGE or TABLEALL

walkin.title: Fushimi Inari at sunrise
walkin.meta: No tickets, open all night. Taxi from the hotel at 05:30. Sunrise is about 06:10; climb to Yotsutsuji for the view.

walkin.title: Weekenders Coffee
walkin.meta: No reservations, opens 7:30, closed Wednesdays. Backup slot: Tue 16 morning.

prep: Check Kikunoi Honten's listing on MY CONCIERGE and TABLEALL (links on kikunoi.jp/en) for Sun 14 March, 2 people, and note the release date and fee.
If neither shows March yet, phone +81-75-561-0015 (Japan daytime is evening or overnight in the Americas) or ask Ace Hotel's concierge once your room is booked.
Pick the course price you're comfortable with before you book; the cheapest menu may not be offered on the booking platforms.
Buy Haruka tickets on JR West's site closer to the date (smartphone QR voucher).

others.title: Haruka Express · Fri 12 in, Tue 16 out
others.desc: KIX ⇄ Kyoto Station, about 75 min. Around ¥3,000–3,600 each way per person; fares vary by source.

deadlines.text: Check Kikunoi's booking window and request Sun 14 March for 2.
One month out. If Kikunoi isn't confirmed, phone or ask the hotel concierge.

days.label: Arrival
days.headline: Arrival
days.title: Land and settle in
days.intro: A soft landing. Straight to Kyoto on the Haruka, check in, and eat close to the hotel. Tomorrow starts before dawn.

lines.name: Karasuma Line to Karasuma Oike, 6 min

items.title: Land at Kansai (KIX)
items.text: Allow about an hour for immigration and bags.

items.title: Haruka to Kyoto Station
items.text: About 75 minutes. Trains run roughly every 30 minutes.

items.title: Karasuma Line to Karasuma Oike
items.text: Two stops north, 6 minutes. The hotel is above exit 5.

items.title: Check in
items.text: Ace Hotel Kyoto.

items.title: Easy dinner nearby
items.text: Shin-Puh-Kan's ground-floor restaurants or anywhere within a few blocks. Early night.

days.label: Fushimi → Downtown
days.headline: Sunrise shrine, then Downtown
days.summary: Fushimi Inari · Weekenders · Nishiki · Ippodo · Pontochō
days.title: Torii at dawn, coffee and market by mid-morning
days.intro: Two of your three must-happens on one day. You beat the crowds to Fushimi Inari, then take the Keihan back into town for Weekenders and Nishiki while they're quiet. Because of the 5:30 start, the hotel break comes early, at 13:00.
days.map_note: Map shows Downtown. Stop 1, Fushimi Inari, is 15–20 min south by taxi.

items.title: Taxi from the hotel
items.text: Hotel front desk can call one. About ¥3,000.

items.title: Fushimi Inari Taisha
items.text: Sunrise about 06:10. Walk up through the Senbon Torii to Yotsutsuji (~45 min), then back down. Free, open all night.

items.title: Keihan Line to Gion-Shijō
items.text: From Fushimi-Inari Station, 8 minutes. Walk west along Shijō, about 15 minutes.

items.title: Weekenders Coffee Tominokoji
items.text: Opens 7:30. Small, mostly standing; take it to go if it's full.

items.title: Nishiki Market
items.text: Saturday, so most stalls are open. Graze for lunch: tamagoyaki, grilled skewers, tofu doughnuts. Eat at each stall, not while walking.

items.title: Ippodo Kaboku tearoom
items.text: Matcha prepared at your table with a seasonal sweet. No reservations; a waitlist forms after lunch. Buy tea to take home here or on Tuesday.

items.title: Hotel break
items.text: Seven minutes' walk. Nap; you've been up since five.

items.title: Dinner in Pontochō
items.text: Walk the alley and pick a place with a posted menu. Skip ones with no prices outside.

days.label: Arashiyama → Kikunoi
days.headline: Bamboo, then Kikunoi
days.summary: Bamboo Grove · Tenryū-ji · Ōkōchi Sansō · Yasaka · Kikunoi Honten
days.title: West at dawn, east for dinner
days.intro: The day is built around Kikunoi. Arashiyama is done by late morning, before the Sunday crowds peak, and you're back at the hotel early to rest before the big dinner. The walk through Yasaka Shrine leads you straight to the door.
days.map_note: Map zooms to Arashiyama. The hotel is 30 min east; stops 4 and 5 are on the east side, 15 min from the hotel by taxi.

items.title: Taxi to Arashiyama
items.text: About 30 minutes and ¥5,000 or so. The trains are slower at this hour.

items.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
items.text: Nearly empty before 8. Walk the full path, slowly.

items.title: Tenryū-ji garden
items.text: Opens 8:30. ¥500 for the garden. Enter or leave by the north gate onto the bamboo path.

items.title: Ōkōchi Sansō
items.text: Hillside villa gardens with views over the city. The ¥1,000 entry includes a bowl of matcha and a sweet at the end.

items.title: Back toward town
items.text: Randen from Arashiyama to Randen-Tenjingawa, then Tōzai Line to Karasuma Oike. About 35 minutes. Eat a light lunch on the way; dinner is long.

items.title: Hotel break
items.text: Rest and change. No dress code is published; smart casual is the safe choice.

items.title: Yasaka Shrine and Maruyama Park
items.text: Taxi 15 minutes. Walk through the shrine and the park; Kikunoi is about 5 minutes up the lane.

items.title: Kikunoi Honten
items.text: Kaiseki for 2. Arrive 5–10 minutes early. Time to be confirmed when you book; dinner seatings start at 17:00. Taxi home, 15 minutes.

days.label: Uji
days.headline: Uji, the tea town
days.title: A morning for matcha
days.intro: Your 'good matcha' day. Uji grows the tea, so it's the place for it. Byōdō-in opens early, the tea house queue is shortest at opening, and you're back by early afternoon.

lines.name: JR Nara Line to Uji, 17–30 min

items.title: Karasuma Line, then JR Nara Line to Uji
items.text: Change at Kyoto Station. Take a Rapid if one is leaving.

items.title: Byōdō-in
items.text: Grounds open 8:30. Get a Phoenix Hall interior ticket as soon as they start selling at 9:00 (+¥300, timed, first come).

items.title: Nakamura Tokichi Honten
items.text: Take a queue ticket on arrival. Matcha, matcha soba, and the jelly parfait. Opening time is listed as 10:00 or 11:00; check before you go.

items.title: Walk the Uji River
items.text: The Uji Bridge and the riverbank tea shops, then back to JR Uji Station.

items.title: Hotel break
items.text: Afternoon off.

items.title: Dinner, your pick
items.text: Unplanned on purpose. Downtown is on foot from the hotel.

days.map_note: Map zooms to Uji. The hotel is 45 min north by subway and JR.

days.label: Departure
days.headline: Last coffee, then home
days.title: A slow last morning
days.intro: Weekenders is your backup slot if Saturday didn't happen, and Ippodo is the place to buy tea to take home. Leave the hotel by 13:15 for an 18:00 flight.

items.title: Weekenders Coffee
items.text: Open Tuesday. A second visit, or the first if Saturday fell through.

items.title: Ippodo Tea, the shop
items.text: Opens 10:00. Matcha tins and hōjicha to take home.

items.title: Check out
items.text: Leave bags at the front desk. Lunch nearby.

items.title: Leave for Kyoto Station
items.text: Karasuma Line, 6 minutes.

items.title: Haruka to Kansai (KIX)
items.text: About 75 minutes. Arrives around 15:00, three hours before the flight.

notes.title: Money
notes.text: Prices are in yen. $1 ≈ ¥156 (latest quote found, 17 Sep 2026; check again before you go). Carry ¥20,000 or so in cash for market stalls and small shops. No tipping.

notes.title: Getting around
notes.text: Load a Suica or ICOCA on your phone's wallet before you fly. It works on the subway, Keihan, Randen and JR. Taxis take cards.

notes.title: Weather
notes.text: Mid-March in Kyoto is cool, about 3–13°C (37–55°F). Bring layers for the 5:30 start.

notes.title: Etiquette
notes.text: No eating while walking in Nishiki. Don't photograph maiko in Gion. Shoes come off in temple buildings.
